steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.endTour?.(); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setLocation?.({ lat: 1.3521, lon: 103.8198, label: 'SG' }); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setQualityTier?.('performance'); })()

steps.name: place-items

steps.name: drawcall-probe
steps.eval: (() => { const g = window.__three && window.__three.gl; const scene = window.__three && window.__three.scene; let mesh = 0, inst = 0; if (scene) scene.traverse((o) => { if (o.isInstancedMesh) inst++; else if (o.isMesh) mesh++; }); console.log('DRAWCALL_PROBE ' + JSON.stringify({ calls: g ? g.info.render.calls : null, meshes: mesh, instancedMeshes: inst })); })()
